dlss_fg.video_settings.tooltip: Opens the Vulkan frame generation, upscaling, diagnostics and hardware ray-tracing settings.
dlss_fg.screen.settings.title: Frame Generation & Graphics
dlss_fg.screen.diagnostics.title: Frame Generation Diagnostics
dlss_fg.tooltip.section.frame_generation: Frame generation, upscaling, latency, motion-debug and compatibility settings for NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs.
dlss_fg.tooltip.section.graphics: Hybrid Vulkan ray-query settings for supported GPUs. Unsupported controls remain disabled and explain their requirements.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.nvidia: Native NVIDIA Streamline controls. DLSS features are enabled only when the driver and GPU report support.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.amd: AMD FidelityFX FSR 3.1 Vulkan controls. FSR 4 frame generation currently requires DirectX 12 and is not used here.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.intel: Intel upscaling and the cross-vendor FSR 3.1 Vulkan frame-generation fallback. Native XeSS-FG requires DirectX 12.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.ray_tracing: Hybrid block shadows and reflections using Vulkan acceleration structures and ray queries.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.presentation: Optional Windows DXGI presentation transport using GPU-shared Vulkan/D3D12 textures and fences.
dlss_fg.tooltip.preset: Applies a coordinated group of frame-generation, latency and quality settings. Choose Custom to adjust controls manually.
dlss_fg.tooltip.run_diagnostics: Shows read-only environment, renderer, provider, resource, D3D12 and real-frame status. It does not change settings. INFO is not a hardware pass.
dlss_fg.tooltip.frame_generation.conflic: Unavailable while %s frame generation is enabled. Disable the active frame-generation provider first; two interpolation providers cannot run together.
dlss_fg.tooltip.frame_generation.enable_: Enable this provider's frame generation before changing its frame multiplier.
dlss_fg.tooltip.frame_generation.hybrid_: Unavailable while the hybrid D3D12 presenter owns the window. Disable it and restart before enabling a Vulkan frame-generation proxy.
dlss_fg.renderer_block.not_initialized: the renderer has not initialized yet
dlss_fg.renderer_block.not_vulkan: the active GpuDevice is not Minecraft's Vulkan device
dlss_fg.renderer_block.opengl: Iris is using OpenGL, so Vulkan resources are unavailable
dlss_fg.renderer_block.iris_shaderpack: an active Iris shader pack requires OpenGL and cannot supply Vulkan resources
dlss_fg.renderer_block.iris_vulkan_unkno: Iris reports an unrecognized Vulkan shader-pipeline state
dlss_fg.renderer_block.aperture_unverifi: Aperture was detected, but no stable frame-resource integration is available
dlss_fg.renderer_block.iris_api: the installed Iris version could not be queried through its public API
dlss_fg.rt_block.waiting_for_device: the Vulkan device is not ready yet
dlss_fg.rt_block.unsupported: the GPU or driver does not expose Vulkan acceleration structures and ray queries
dlss_fg.rt_block.extensions_not_enabled: the required Vulkan ray-query extensions were not enabled when the device was created
dlss_fg.rt_block.backend_pending: the ray-tracing scene backend is not ready
dlss_fg.tooltip.performance_osd: Shows frame rate, pacing latency, active backend and captured-frame counters while playing.
dlss_fg.tooltip.motion_debug: Visualizes the motion-vector input used by frame generation. Arrows show direction, Heatmap shows magnitude and Raw Preview shows the sampled vector field. Visible only in a loaded world.
dlss_fg.tooltip.optiscaler: Enables the bundled OptiScaler bridge on AMD and Intel. A restart is required. An external copy in %s overrides the bundled runtime. NVIDIA always uses native Streamline.
dlss_fg.tooltip.auto_fallback: Keeps rendering through the compatible reconstruction or native presentation path when frame generation is unavailable. It never sends vendor work to an incompatible ABI.
dlss_fg.tooltip.hybrid_d3d12: After restart, replaces Vulkan WSI presentation with a DXGI flip-model swapchain on the same GPU. Enabling it disables Vulkan frame-generation proxies so only one presenter owns the window. This transport alone is not FSR 4 or XeSS-FG.
dlss_fg.tooltip.hybrid_d3d12.safety: Activates only after LUID matching, external-memory format checks, two shared GPU fences and shared-image creation all succeed. A setup failure falls back to the normal Vulkan swapchain for the session.
dlss_fg.presentation_block.not_ready: the same-adapter D3D12 device and Vulkan external-memory bridge are not ready
dlss_fg.presentation_block.failed: the bridge failed safely; see its detail row and latest.log for the exact native reason
dlss_fg.tooltip.motion_blur: Applies a post-reconstruction compute pass along the renderer motion vectors. Unsupported output formats fall back safely without the effect.
dlss_fg.tooltip.motion_blur_intensity: Controls the distance sampled along each motion vector. Lower values reduce smearing during fast camera turns.
dlss_fg.tooltip.drs: Adjusts the renderer-owned world resolution gradually to maintain the configured target frame rate. Requires an active temporal upscaler.
dlss_fg.tooltip.drs_target: Target rendered-frame rate used by the dynamic-resolution controller. The scale changes only after sustained load or headroom.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.frame_generation: Generates additional presented frames through NVIDIA Streamline. Requires a supported NVIDIA GPU, current driver, Reflex and valid color, depth and motion-vector inputs.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.reflex: Reduces the render queue and coordinates CPU/GPU latency. Frame Generation automatically requires Reflex to remain enabled.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.dlss_mode: Selects DLAA or a DLSS Super Resolution quality mode. Lower internal resolutions improve performance but can reduce fine detail.
dlss_fg.status.frame_generation.inactive: Inactive: no compatible GPU or native library | FG VRAM 0.00 MB
dlss_fg.status.header.frame_metrics.no_v: Frame Generation active: %s | VRAM: not measured yet
dlss_fg.status.header.present_rate: MC presents: %s/s | FG multiplier: %sx | display total ~%s/s (derived)
dlss_fg.status.presentation.safety: GPU-only transport · safe fallback · restart required
dlss_fg.backend_status.disabled: turned off (game paused or disabled in settings)
dlss_fg.backend_status.no_world: no world loaded; nothing to generate
dlss_fg.backend_status.paused: paused; resumes when you close this screen
dlss_fg.backend_status.d3d12_required: this native FG route requires Direct3D 12
dlss_fg.backend_status.native_bridge_una: native bridge is unavailable or outdated
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.dlss_status: Read-only result of the NVIDIA Streamline hardware and driver capability query. Check latest.log for the exact rejection reason.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.fg_multiplier: Selects the presented-frame multiplier reported by Streamline. 2x inserts one generated frame; higher Multi Frame Generation levels require supported hardware.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.reflex_pacing: Uses measured frame time to smooth presentation pacing alongside NVIDIA Reflex. This does not create additional frames by itself.
dlss_fg.tooltip.amd.frame_generation: Inserts one generated frame through the FidelityFX FSR 3.1 Vulkan provider. The control activates only after the provider accepts the required renderer inputs.
dlss_fg.tooltip.amd.upscaling: Selects the AMD Vulkan reconstruction path. Native AA renders 1:1; Quality through Ultra Performance render the world below display resolution and reconstruct it before the UI is composed.
dlss_fg.tooltip.intel.frame_generation: Uses the cross-vendor FSR 3.1 Vulkan provider on Intel GPUs. It is intentionally not labeled XeSS-FG because native XeSS Frame Generation requires DirectX 12.
dlss_fg.tooltip.intel.upscaling: Selects the Intel-compatible reconstruction path through OptiScaler. Native AA and reduced-resolution Quality through Ultra Performance modes use the renderer-owned world target.
dlss_fg.tooltip.fsr.fg_factor: FSR 3.1 inserts exactly one generated frame and therefore supports a 2x presented-frame factor only.
dlss_fg.tooltip.frame_multiplier_fixed: 2x is fixed on this vendor: FSR 3.1 inserts exactly one generated frame.
dlss_fg.tooltip.aa_sharpness: Controls reconstruction sharpening. High values produce a crisper image but can emphasize shimmering and halos.
dlss_fg.tooltip.ui_recomposition: Keeps HUD and menus out of generated world frames and composites the interface afterward to reduce ghosting around text and crosshairs.
dlss_fg.tooltip.provider_status: Read-only provider status. On means the Vulkan proxy-swapchain transport is available; Off means the native provider is not ready.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.mode: Enables hybrid ray-traced block shadows or shadows plus reflections while keeping the normal raster renderer active. Requires Vulkan acceleration structures and ray queries.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.quality: Selects a coordinated ray-tracing quality preset. Higher levels increase scene detail and GPU cost.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.distance: Maximum block radius included in the ray-traced scene. Longer distances increase geometry updates, VRAM use and tracing cost.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.samples: Rays traced per pixel. More samples reduce noise but increase GPU workload substantially.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.stable_sampling: Stabilizes the hybrid ray-query result across frames to reduce noise and flicker. It can make rapid lighting changes converge more slowly.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.runtime_status: Read-only state of the live ray-tracing runtime. A failure points to latest.log for the Vulkan error.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.ray_reconstruction: Uses NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction with HDR and material guides. Requires supported NVIDIA hardware and an active DLSS quality mode.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.pipeline_status: Read-only driver capability. The RT pipeline extension is reported separately from ray-query support.
dlss_fg.osd.title: ⚡ FRAME GENERATION OSD
dlss_fg.tooltip.shader_pack_auto_boost: Turns on frame generation when a shader pack starts, including packs with their own ray tracing such as Rethinking Voxels, and DLSS (Quality) when the shader engine can render below window size (Vitrail). You can change everything afterwards; it only applies again the next time a pack starts.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.upscaling: Upscaler, dynamic resolution, motion blur and sharpening for your GPU.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.status: Live state of frame generation, ray tracing and presentation.
dlss_fg.screen.settings.hint: Point at a setting to see what it does.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.replace_terrain: Near terrain fully inside the RT range is drawn only by the RT engine and skipped by Minecraft's renderer, which saves GPU time. Turn off if blocks close to you look wrong.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.shader_pack: Shader for the mod's own RT engine, from the rtshaderpacks folder in the game directory (a copy of the built-in one is there as template). Iris shader packs are loaded by Iris; while one is active the mod's RT stays off.
dlss_fg.rt_block.shader_pack: off while a shader pack runs; the pack lights the world itself
dlss_fg.tooltip.sodium.frame_generation: Generates extra presented frames with the provider for your GPU: DLSS-G on NVIDIA RTX 40/50, FSR 3.1 on AMD and as a fallback on Intel. Stays off where the hardware or driver does not support it.
dlss_fg.tooltip.sodium.upscaler: Renders the world at a lower resolution and reconstructs it: DLSS on NVIDIA, FSR/OptiScaler on AMD, XeSS/FSR on Intel. Native renders at full resolution with temporal anti-aliasing only.
dlss_fg.tooltip.sodium.full_settings: Opens the complete settings screen with vendor-specific options, presets, the Vulkan to D3D12 path and the diagnostics report.
dlss_fg.motion_debug.title: === Motion Vector Debug ===
dlss_fg.motion_debug.snapshot.pending: GPU readback pending; camera preview active (frame %s)
dlss_fg.motion_debug.snapshot.waiting: GPU snapshot: waiting for submitted motion (frame %s)
dlss_fg.motion_debug.move_hint: Move or turn the camera to see vectors
dlss_fg.motion_debug.arrow_legend: GPU vectors: arrows show current-to-previous SDK motion (camera look direction)
dlss_fg.motion_debug.heatmap_legend: HEATMAP: blue=slow  green=medium  red=fast  max=%s px
dlss_fg.motion_debug.raw.values: Raw X: %s px   Raw Y: %s px   |V|: %s
dlss_fg.diagnostics.backend.none_selecte: No active GPU provider was detected. See latest.log for the native loader details.
dlss_fg.diagnostics.backend.not_selected: %s: not tested because this provider is not selected for the detected GPU.
